title: Geodata and base maps
text: bfs_get_base_maps() gives cartographic base maps BFS (ThemaKart project) sf objects. first time, downloads zip file several hundred files saves disk (cache). bfs_clear_cache() deletes cache.
code: switzerland <- bfs_get_base_maps(geom = "suis") cantons <- bfs_get_base_maps(geom = "kant") districts <- bfs_get_base_maps(geom = "bezk") communes <- bfs_get_base_maps(geom = "polg") capitals <- bfs_get_base_maps(geom = "stkt", type = "Pnts", category = "kk") lakes <- bfs_get_base_maps(geom = "seen", category = "11") rivers <- bfs_get_base_maps(geom = "flus", category = "22", type = "") # rivers have no type  ggplot() +   geom_sf(data = communes, fill = "snow", color = "grey45") +   geom_sf(data = lakes, fill = "lightblue2", color = "black") +   geom_sf(data = districts, fill = "transparent", color = "grey65") +   geom_sf(data = cantons, fill = "transparent", color = "black") +   geom_sf(data = rivers, color = "lightblue2", linewidth = 1) +   geom_sf(data = capitals, shape = 18, size = 3) +   theme_void() +   labs(caption = "Source: ThemaKart, © BFS")

title: API errors and rate limits
text: Sometimes API answer. example, sent many requests (HTTP 429), API slow (timeout), server problem. functions give error starts “BFS API available.”: internet connection, functions give message “internet connection” return NULL.
code: Error: ! The BFS API is not available. ℹ HTTP 429 Too Many Requests. Caused by error in `httr2::req_perform()`: ! HTTP 429 Too Many Requests.

title: API errors and rate limits
text: PXWeb API accepts limited number requests IP address given time (see configuration). bfs_get_data() sends two requests: one variables dataset, one data. use loop: Wait calls, example delay = 10 (seconds) Sys.sleep(). Save results. Don’t download data . still get error, dataset may big API. download part query (see Data catalog PXWeb datasets), whole PX file bfs_download_asset() (see Tables files).

what: Handle the errors in your code
title: API errors and rate limits
text: errors class bfs_http_error. can handle code, example try later skip dataset: error also keeps original classes fields. example, can use httr2_http_429 response e$resp, http_429 errors pxweb package: also find original error e$parent.
code: data <- tryCatch(   bfs_get_data(number_bfs = "px-x-1502040100_131", language = "en"),   bfs_http_error = function(e) {     message("Skipped: ", conditionMessage(e))     NULL   } ) tryCatch(   bfs_sse_dimensions("DF_LWZ_1"),   httr2_http_429 = function(e) httr2::resp_retry_after(e$resp) )
